description.en: Basilosaurus isis: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m ART SETTING. Voss2019 Fig1A CGM42195 15m adult display cast supports extreme elongate trunk and vestigial hindlimbs. Fig1B Dorudon is not the target. Skin, muted slate palette, body width, swimming pose, tiny hindfoot flesh, nostrils and horizontal terminal flukes are artistic/comparative inferences, not directly preserved soft tissues. No dorsal fin invented.
